local_origin_definition: Initial rear axle center and initial body heading; algorithm pose=(0,0,0). World origin transform stored below is evaluation-only.
actual_terminal_world_initialization_sou: P11.7.6 final physical trace only; not fed to SLAM/map/planning/controller

bay_recognition.source: Fresh occupied long-line pair only; no historical target/scene obstacle coordinates.

budget.caveat: Engineering local uncertainty budget; Gaussian 3-sigma is per-measurement probabilistic and NOT a deterministic or joint confidence certificate. Slip/model error is monitored using scan innovations, IMU and final independent evaluation.

continuous.proof: Distance to a closed obstacle set is 1-Lipschitz under rigid-body Hausdorff displacement. Every interpolated pose lies within the reported half-interval motion cover of an endpoint sample; subtracting it certifies each entire continuous segment.
continuous.perturbation_note: 27 explicit translation/yaw combinations are illustrative checks. The Minkowski disk bound and continuous clearance certificate cover all combinations, not just this finite set.

independent_physical_audit.distance_definition: Nearest rear-axle reference polyline distance during automatic phases; NOT timestamp-aligned. Terminal error separately compares final actual rear axle to last path node.

execution_stage_summary.forward: Actual low-speed exploration, encoder-terminated near +0.8m local X
execution_stage_summary.adjustment: New planner selected an all-reverse moving path; no additional automatic forward adjustment was needed.
